text:
Kim (Support): NovusHealth trial ingest blocked — embeddings returning 403 "quota_inactive" since 8:15 AM ET. They're mid-onboarding and have a renewal check in ~10 days. Escalating to CS :exclamation:

Ari (CSM): Copy. Paste account and a repro/snippet? I'll draft a short customer note once we unblock.

Kim (Support): Account: novus-420
Repro:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_novus_***' -d '{"input":"patient summary"}'
HTTP/1.1 403
{"error":"quota_inactive","detail":"no_active_quota"}
```

Tess (CS Ops): Checking admin: novus-420 -> plan=trial-basic, active_quota=0, billing=payment_failed. Looks like provisioning didn't finalize.

Dev (AE): They're on a tight pilot timeline. If onboarding stops they may push decision back. This needs fast unblock and a call.

Ari (CSM): Proposed quick plan:
- Ops: temp quota bump to let them finish ingest (Tess)
- Support: confirm logs & repro (Kim)
- CS: 20m sync with champion + PM to capture product feedback (Ari + Dev)
- Billing: attempt payment recovery and advise on permanent quota (BillingBot)
Owners: Tess, Kim, Ari, Dev.

Tess (CS Ops): Applying temporary quota now — tagging as temp-unblock-novus-420. ETA ~10m.

BillingBot: Billing event novus-420: last_payment=card_declined. Recovery email queued to finance@novushealth.com at 1830000125.

Kim (Support): Quick log note: their SDK defaulted to batch_size=250 which burned quota on first import. Recommend we surface default batch guidance.

Tess (CS Ops): Temp quota enabled at 1830000300: +40k vectors/day for 48h. Audit recorded.

Kim (Support): Verified with customer post-bump — ingest progressing. They reported better throughput after reducing batch_size to 32.

Ari (CSM): Great. Immediate next steps:
- I will send a short note to the champion apologizing and scheduling a 20m sync for tomorrow 10:00 AM ET.
- Kim: please include the minimal repro and the SDK batch recommendation in the invite.
- Tess: follow up with billing on payment recovery and perm quota restore.
- Dev: prepare a 2-slide upgrade/benefit summary for the call.

Dev (AE): On it. I'll also include a reserved-capacity option in case they need guaranteed latency.

Kim (Support): From support perspective this is resolved. Leaving thread open for CS + billing follow-ups.

Ari (CSM): Thanks all. I'll post the customer message and meeting notes back here after the call. :thumbsup:
